urunler.kisa: Hafif alüminyum-titanyum alaşım gövde, 360°×185° döner hortum mafsalı, 360° ayarlanabilir reaksiyon kolu ve 1½" kare tahrik. M30–M64 cıvatalarda ±%3 tekrarlanabilir tork.
urunler.en_kisa: Lightweight aluminium-titanium alloy housing, 360°×185° swivel hose manifold, 360° adjustable reaction arm and 1½" square drive. Repeatable torque within ±3% on M30–M64 bolts.
urunler.gorsel: a compact square-drive hydraulic torque wrench: monoblock machined aluminium body in matt black, a 1.5 inch square drive protruding from the side, a hinged reaction arm, a twin swivel hose manifold on top with two short high-pressure hose stubs

urunler.ad: Kare Tahrikli Hidrolik Tork Anahtarı, Ağır Seri
urunler.en: Square Drive Hydraulic Torque Wrench, Heavy Series
urunler.kisa: M42–M90 cıvatalar için yüksek tork kapasitesi. Alüminyum-titanyum alaşım gövde, 360° ayarlanabilir reaksiyon kolu ve 360°×185° döner hortum mafsalı.
urunler.en_kisa: High torque capacity for M42–M90 bolts. Aluminium-titanium alloy housing, 360° adjustable reaction arm and 360°×185° swivel hose manifold.
urunler.gorsel: a large heavy-series square-drive hydraulic torque wrench, bulky machined steel and matt black aluminium body, oversized 2.5 inch square drive, thick reinforced reaction arm resting on the surface, swivel hose manifold on top

urunler.kisa: Altıgen kaset başlığı sayesinde lokma sığmayan dar flanşlarda çalışır. Kaset değiştirerek farklı somun ölçülerine uyum.
urunler.en_kisa: The hexagon cassette head works on tight flanges where a socket will not fit. Swap cassettes to cover different nut sizes.
urunler.gorsel: a low-profile hydraulic cassette torque wrench: slim flat elongated body with an open hexagon ratchet cassette head at the front, a compact matt black power cylinder at the rear, short swivel hose coupling, very thin profile seen from three-quarter view

urunler.kisa: Kapalı devre tork kontrolü, renkli ekran ve sıkma kayıtlarının USB ile aktarımı. Kalibrasyon sertifikası ile teslim.
urunler.en_kisa: Closed-loop torque control, colour display and USB export of every tightening record. Supplied with a calibration certificate.
urunler.gorsel: an industrial electric torque wrench: cylindrical gearbox housing in machined steel, pistol-style matt black handle with a small dark digital display, a reaction arm bracket at the front, 1 inch square drive, coiled power cable

urunler.kisa: Kablosuz saha çalışması için 36 V akü, iki kademeli hız ve otomatik kapanma. Rüzgar türbini ve kule bakımları için hafif çözüm.
urunler.en_kisa: 36 V battery for cordless field work, two speed settings and auto shut-off. A light solution for wind turbine and tower maintenance.
urunler.gorsel: a cordless battery-powered industrial torque wrench: long cylindrical planetary gearbox in machined steel, matt black grip with a slide-in battery pack at the base, reaction arm at the nose, 3/4 inch square drive

urunler.kisa: 1:125 dişli oranı ile küçük bir manuel tork anahtarından yüksek çıkış torku. Elektrik ve hava olmayan sahalar için.
urunler.en_kisa: A 1:125 gear ratio turns a small manual torque wrench into high output torque. For sites without power or air.
urunler.gorsel: a manual torque multiplier: cylindrical planetary gearbox drum in machined steel, a long flat reaction arm extending sideways, 1/2 inch square input on top, 1.5 inch square output below

urunler.kisa: Cıvatayı burulmadan, eksenel olarak gerdirir. Birden fazla gerdirme aleti tek pompaya bağlanarak flanşın eşit yüklenmesi sağlanır.
urunler.en_kisa: Stretches the bolt axially without torsion. Several tensioners on one pump load the flange evenly.
urunler.gorsel: a hydraulic bolt tensioner: stacked cylindrical tool made of a machined steel load cell, a bridge with a side window showing a hex nut, a top puller nut, a single high-pressure coupler on the side

urunler.kisa: Krom-molibden çelik, fosfat kaplı darbe lokmaları. Hidrolik tork anahtarlarıyla birlikte 46–95 mm aralığında 9 parça.
urunler.en_kisa: Chrome-molybdenum steel impact sockets with phosphate finish. Nine pieces from 46 to 95 mm for hydraulic torque wrenches.
urunler.gorsel: a set of nine heavy-duty impact sockets in graduated sizes, matt black phosphate finish, arranged in a precise row in a fitted foam tray, each socket with crisp hexagon interior

urunler.kisa: Yay geri dönüşlü, sertleştirilmiş krom pistonlu genel amaçlı silindir. Kaldırma, itme, presleme ve hizalama işleri için.
urunler.en_kisa: General purpose cylinder with spring return and hardened chrome plunger. For lifting, pushing, pressing and alignment.
urunler.gorsel: a single-acting hydraulic cylinder standing upright: thick machined steel barrel with a matt black coat, polished chrome plunger slightly extended with a grooved saddle on top, a coupler half on the side near the base

urunler.kisa: Sadece 57 mm kapalı yükseklik ile makine altı ve dar boşluklarda kaldırma. Somun tipi kilitleme seçeneği.
urunler.en_kisa: Only 57 mm collapsed height for lifting under machinery and in tight gaps. Lock nut option available.
urunler.gorsel: a very flat low-height hydraulic pancake cylinder: wide short machined steel puck shape, matt black side, a thin chrome plunger face on top, small coupler on the side

urunler.kisa: Hidrolik geri dönüş, köprü ve bina kaldırma gibi senkron uygulamalar için iki bağlantı portu ve emniyet valfi.
urunler.en_kisa: Hydraulic return, two ports and a safety valve for synchronous applications such as bridge and building lifting.
urunler.gorsel: a massive double-acting hydraulic cylinder, very wide machined steel barrel in matt black with two hose couplers on the side, chrome plunger with a tilt saddle, standing on a steel plate

urunler.kisa: İki kademeli akış, uzaktan kumandalı 4/3 yön valfi ve 10 litre çelik tank. Tork anahtarı ve çift etkili silindirler için.
urunler.en_kisa: Two-stage flow, remote-controlled 4/3 directional valve and a 10 litre steel tank. For torque wrenches and double-acting cylinders.
urunler.gorsel: an electric hydraulic power pack: rectangular steel oil reservoir, an electric motor mounted on top with a protective roll cage frame in matt black, a glycerin pressure gauge with a black dial, a manual 4-way valve lever, two hose couplers

urunler.kisa: Düşük basınçta hızlı yaklaşma, yüksek basınçta hassas kontrol. Hafif alüminyum tank, kilitli kol.
urunler.en_kisa: Fast approach at low pressure, precise control at high pressure. Lightweight aluminium reservoir and lockable handle.
urunler.gorsel: a two-speed hydraulic hand pump: long horizontal cylindrical aluminium reservoir, a tall pivoting pump handle raised at an angle, a release valve knob, a short hose with a coupler at the end

urunler.kisa: Atölye hava hattından çalışır, ayakla kontrol edilen basınç ve tahliye. Elleri serbest bırakan tasarım.
urunler.en_kisa: Runs on the workshop air line, with pressure and release controlled by foot. Keeps both hands free.
urunler.gorsel: an air-driven hydraulic foot pump: low flat body lying on the floor with a wide foot pedal, an air inlet fitting, a pressure gauge, a short high-pressure hose

urunler.kisa: Termoplastik, 4:1 emniyet katsayılı hidrolik hortum. Bir ucunda dişi kaplin, diğer ucunda erkek kaplin.
urunler.en_kisa: Thermoplastic hydraulic hose with a 4:1 safety factor. Female coupler on one end, male coupler on the other.
urunler.gorsel: a coiled black thermoplastic high-pressure hydraulic hose forming a loose loop, machined steel couplers at both ends with knurled collars

urunler.kisa: Sistem basıncını hat üzerinde izlemek için. 63 mm gliserinli manometre, ton ve bar skalalı kadran.
urunler.en_kisa: Monitors system pressure in line. 63 mm glycerin-filled gauge with ton and bar scale.
urunler.gorsel: a hydraulic pressure gauge mounted on a machined steel tee adaptor block, round glycerin-filled gauge with a stainless rim and a matte black dial with fine tick marks, no readable numbers

urunler.kisa: Entegre pompa ve rezervuarlı, kendi kendine yeten kaldırma ünitesi. Bakım atölyeleri ve saha kaldırmaları için.
urunler.en_kisa: Self-contained lifting unit with integrated pump and reservoir. For maintenance workshops and site lifting.
urunler.gorsel: a heavy industrial hydraulic bottle jack: square steel base, cylindrical body in matt black, chrome ram with a ridged saddle, a pump socket on the side and a detachable steel lever lying next to it

urunler.kisa: Kademeli kama ile 6 mm'lik boşluğa girip flanşları 81 mm'ye kadar açar. Conta değişimleri ve vana bakımları için.
urunler.en_kisa: The stepped wedge enters a 6 mm gap and spreads flanges up to 81 mm. For gasket changes and valve maintenance.
urunler.gorsel: a hydraulic wedge flange spreader: compact steel cylinder body with a stepped wedge jaw at the front made of hardened steel, a safety block, a coupler at the rear

urunler.kisa: Kaçık flanşları radyal yönde ±10 mm'ye kadar hizalar. Cıvata deliğine geçen kanca ile tek kişi kullanımı.
urunler.en_kisa: Aligns misaligned flanges radially by up to ±10 mm. The hook passes through the bolt hole for one-person operation.
urunler.gorsel: a hydraulic flange alignment tool: an L-shaped hardened steel hook frame with a small hydraulic cylinder mounted on it, a coupler, lying next to two thick steel pipe flanges slightly misaligned

urunler.kisa: Rulman, dişli ve kasnak sökümü için kendinden pompalı hidrolik çektirme. Kollar tek hareketle eşit açılır.
urunler.en_kisa: Self-contained hydraulic puller for removing bearings, gears and pulleys. The jaws open evenly in one movement.
urunler.gorsel: a three-jaw hydraulic gear puller: a central hydraulic cylinder with a long chrome spindle, three hinged forged steel jaws in matt black spread evenly around a steel hub, an integrated hand pump handle

urunler.kisa: Paslanmış ve sıkışmış somunları cıvataya zarar vermeden keser. Değiştirilebilir sertleştirilmiş keski ucu.
urunler.en_kisa: Splits rusted and seized nuts without damaging the bolt. Replaceable hardened chisel.
urunler.gorsel: a hydraulic nut splitter: a compact steel ring-shaped head with an inner chisel blade pointing at a rusty hex nut on a threaded stud, a short cylinder body and a coupler

urunler.kisa: Boru hatları, vanalar ve basınçlı kaplar için hava tahrikli test pompası. Paslanmaz çelik çerçeve, iki manometre.
urunler.en_kisa: Air-driven test pump for pipelines, valves and pressure vessels. Stainless steel frame with two gauges.
urunler.gorsel: an air-driven hydrostatic test pump unit: a tubular stainless steel frame with carry handles, a vertical pneumatic booster cylinder, two large round pressure gauges with blank dark dials, high-pressure needle valves
